div.div: 3 رادس القَوْمَ i. q. رَدَسَهُمْ [explained above, in the first sentence]: (S, TA:) [or He threw stones at the people, or party, they doing so at him; or pelted them with stones, they pelting him: for the inf. n.] مُرَادَسَةٌ is explained in the O and K as meaning مُرَايَاةٌ; but the correct explanation may be مُرَامَاةٌ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
